buffer_judgment: A fixed one-ATR buffer is a meaningful competing action hypothesis because it distinguishes any decline from a decline larger than a previously observed volatility unit. It may reduce false exits but can also exit too late, allow a profitable cycle to become a loss or fail to precede originalcost/support. It has not been shown to improve the original annual goals.

precision_of_meaning: ATR20prior is mean true range in source price units, including intrabar range and gaps. OneATR is not a standard deviation, confidence bound, probability of reversal or guaranteed maximum normal one-day movement. FrozenATR removes the old dynamic-ATR contraction mechanism; it adds no new external information.
